Basics

Liver dumplings

Májgaluska

8 months+ Adjusted 25 min 1 portion

From 8 months. This portion is the liver meal for the week, so do not also serve liver spread or give a vitamin A supplement. Chop any dumpling that is still large.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 20 g raw chicken liver (about 15 g once cooked; the child's whole share)
  • 1 tbsp beaten egg (cooked until fully set)
  • 1 tbsp plain breadcrumbs (wheat, with no salted seasoning)
  • 1 tsp chopped parsley (fresh)
  • 250 ml unsalted stock (the homemade stock, not a cube)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Simmer the liver in the unsalted stock until it is cooked through and no pink remains.
  2. Lift it out and check the cooked weight is about 15 g for the child.
  3. Blend that liver with the egg, breadcrumbs, and parsley.
  4. Shape a few small dumplings.
  5. Return them to the simmering stock and cook until the egg is set and the centres are hot.
  6. Serve the dumplings in a spoon of stock.

Adjusted

Liver is very rich in vitamin A, so the child's share must stay small even in a soup.

Cook a few small dumplings of chicken liver, egg, breadcrumbs, and parsley in unsalted stock until fully done. Give the child about 15 g cooked liver, at most once a week, and not alongside a vitamin A supplement.
